DEPLOYMENT-CONTRACT.md §2 (baked versus mounted). The bundle's identity is the JCS hash of the whole document (it carries no hash of its own). Every policy value is optional: an absent supervisor or router value is the shipped default (gen2/supervisor/supervisor.py Policy; the router's hold window), so a bundle overrides only what it names. The newer policies (retry, reservations, signal queue) have no shipped default: while absent, the operation they govern is refused, never unbounded. additionalProperties false throughout: a misspelt value is a refused bundle, not a silent default
title: Engine configuration bundle
description: One mounted engine configuration set, activated by the router as a versioned bundle (config-bundle/1): the execution policy the supervisor and the router apply, and the question registry DecisionSpecs pin to. New work pins the active bundle; work already admitted keeps the one it was admitted under.

version.description: Strictly above every bundle activated before it; activating the active bundle again is a replay.

supervisor.description: Overrides of the supervisor's Policy fields (gen2/supervisor/supervisor.py); each absent one keeps its shipped default.

hold_window_s.description: The deadline of a hold the router opens (an outcome_unknown episode's, an exhausted retry budget's): how long its owner has before it is overdue, in seconds, fractions kept: the deadline is the hold's creation instant plus exactly this duration, to the nanosecond, a finer fraction rounding up (so a positive window is never zero). Shipped default 3600.

retry.description: Policy-driven re-queue of failed or cancelled work (L-6): known transient failure classes are re-queued within the budget; anything else is the operator's.

attempts.description: Re-runs a policy may request after the first attempt.

min_band.description: The declared threshold: an operator-confirmed facet rating at or above it (G-5).

signal_queue.description: The coalesced signal queue (flow S5): at most `budget` signal-driven reviews per topic within `window_s`, none within `cooldown_s` of the last. Mandatory signals and the fixed cadence floor are never held back by it (G-12).

questions.description: The question registry entries this bundle carries (flow §5). A question version has one content forever: its content_hash is the JCS hash of the entry minus itself (C-13).
